description: Canonical greenfield design-system interview state machine. All surfaces must agree with this file.

existing_direction_shortcut.condition: User supplies a sufficiently specific direction covering >=5 of the 9 core dimensions
existing_direction_shortcut.behavior: Confirm the committed direction and emit the token block without running the full interview

required.label: Visual reference / personality anchor
required.abstention_default: No direction committed; derive a recommendation from audience, task, domain, and supplied references, then mark it pending confirmation

required.label: Brand personality spectrum
required.abstention_default: Do not choose a personality pole without evidence; recommend the least-risk credible stance and mark it pending confirmation

required.label: Aesthetic territory
required.abstention_default: Do not select a visual territory by convention; derive one from content, audience, domain, and evidence, or abstain pending confirmation

required.label: Typography stance
required.abstention_default: Do not prescribe a font pairing without language, reading, brand, and performance evidence; record the unresolved choice

required.label: Color and mode
required.abstention_default: Do not assume a hue or mode; derive semantic roles from brand, contrast, theme, and content evidence, or abstain

required.label: Density and shape language
required.abstention_default: Derive density and shape from content, interaction, platform, and brand evidence; do not import a token recipe

required.label: Layout structure and rhythm
required.abstention_default: Derive structure and rhythm from content hierarchy and container evidence; do not assume a column count or base unit

required.label: Signature element or distinctive touch
required.abstention_default: Do not erase distinctiveness by default; identify a credible signature from the brief or record an explicit abstention

required.label: Imagery and iconography approach
required.abstention_default: Do not choose an imagery or icon recipe without subject, rights, accessibility, and brand evidence; record the open decision

optional.label: Motion and transition character
optional.skip_condition: User says motion is out of scope, site is purely static, or budget excludes it
optional.abstention_default: Do not add motion by convention; derive purpose, interruption tolerance, and reduced-motion behavior from evidence, or abstain

interruption_resume.resume_signal: User supplies previously unanswered dimensions mid-session
interruption_resume.behavior: Resume from the unanswered dimension; do not restart

contradiction_handling.behavior: Surface the contradiction, propose a resolution, confirm before committing

abstention_handling.behavior: Apply the dimension's abstention_default and state what was decided
abstention_handling.trust_critical_behavior: When trust_critical=true, select a credibility-appropriate default and explain why

sample_menu_trap.behavior: Refuse to offer samples as a menu. Samples are illustrative case studies, not choices. Derive a new system via the interview.

headless_behavior.behavior: Surface all forcing questions with recommended defaults. Do not commit the system without user confirmation unless the brief already supplies sufficient direction.

required_sections: Token block (complete, with canonical CSS custom property names)
artifact.completion_criteria: All 9 required dimensions decided and the token block complete; approved status additionally requires explicit confirmation

status_semantics.approved: The direction is confirmed and buildable; implementation handoff is allowed
status_semantics.approval-ready: Recommendations and tokens are complete but await confirmation; do not hand off to implementation
status_semantics.blocked: A contradiction or missing authority prevents a safe recommendation

not_ready_signals: Trust-critical domain with no credibility rationale
readiness.ready_signal: All required dimensions decided and explicitly confirmed; abstentions retain their evidence-dependent recommendation

downstream_notes.art-direction: imagery_iconography dimension feeds directly into art-direction source-and-rights decisions
downstream_notes.micro-motion: optional motion dimension feeds into micro-motion token plan
